name: app-check-client-initialize-twice
description: initializeAppCheck called a second time on the same app: with identical options (same provider instance), with a new provider instance built from the same factory, and with a different isTokenAutoRefreshEnabled.

differentAutoRefresh.name: FirebaseError
differentAutoRefresh.message: AppCheck: You have already called initializeAppCheck() for FirebaseApp twice with different options. To avoid this error, call initializeAppCheck() with the same options as when it was originally called. This will return the already initialized instance. (appCheck/already-initialized).
